name: acronis-mcp
description: The first real CLI for the Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud platform — every tenant, agent, and usage metric mirrored locally, with cross-tenant rollups no single API call returns.

acronis_bearer_auth.title: ACRONIS_BEARER_AUTH
acronis_bearer_auth.description: Sets ACRONIS_BEARER_AUTH for the Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud MCP server.

acronis_datacenter.title: ACRONIS_DATACENTER
acronis_datacenter.description: Sets ACRONIS_DATACENTER for the endpoint template variable {datacenter}.

acronis_client_id.title: Acronis API client ID
acronis_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID of the Acronis API client (Acronis console: Settings > API clients). Used with ACRONIS_CLIENT_SECRET to mint a bearer token.

acronis_client_secret.title: Acronis API client secret
acronis_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with ACRONIS_CLIENT_ID. Acronis shows it once, when the API client is created.

acronis_base_url.title: Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud API base URL
acronis_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from ACRONIS_DATACENTER. Set it only to point at a different host.

acronis_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
acronis_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

acronis_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
acronis_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

acronis_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
acronis_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

acronis_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
acronis_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Acronis requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
